description.en: Attacks an enemy and <color=#28d9ed>heals</color> the caster's Health by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> of damage dealt.
description.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、ダメージの<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>、自分のHPを<color=#28d9ed>回復</color>する。
description.zh: 攻击敌人，并使自身的生命值<color=#28d9ed>恢复</color>相当于伤害量的<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。

description.en: Attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>25%</color> chance to reduce the target's <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn(s)</color>.
description.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>25%</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
description.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>25%</color> 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다
description.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>25%</color>的几率使目标的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

description.en:
(Passive Effect)
<color=#ffd732>Upon death, grants 50 Action Points and 4 Chain Points for each enemy.</color>

Deals <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> of <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color> as fixed damage to one target when attacking.
description.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
<color=#ffd732>倒れた時、敵全体にAPを50、CPを4獲得させる。</color>

攻撃時、対象単体に<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>の<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>の固定ダメージを与える。
description.kr:
(패시브 효과)
<color=#ffd732>사망 시 적 한 명당 AP 50, CP 4 씩 회복시킵니다.</color>

공격 시 대상 한명에게 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>의 <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> 만큼 고정 피해를 입힙니다.
description.zh:
(被动效果)
<color=#ffd732>死亡时，使每个敌人的AP恢复50、CP恢复4。</color>

攻击时，对1个目标造成相当于<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color><color=#28d9ed>5%</color>的固定伤害。
